# What is attention?

## Summary

Attention is a content-based key-value lookup over a sequence of vectors [[example-paper-aabbccdd]]. It enables transformers to model long-range dependencies without recurrence [[example-paper-aabbccdd]].

> "Attention is a weighted sum of value vectors where the weights are derived from the similarity of queries to keys."
